manual.interpretation: MissionTurnround.TID links a defined Tasks row; TaskBreakDown SEQ rows run strictly in order, and their summed durations override the turnround scalar DURN. Custom subtask identifiers represent time/resource demand only.

limits: This probes one custom two-step turnround on one aircraft and two deterministic missions; it does not establish arbitrary breakdown, waiting resources, same-time ordering, GUI-only behavior, cross-engine equivalence, full B04.var05 or Issue 18 completion.
